title: hypericum origanifolium var. depilatum
intro: Hypericum origanifolium var. depilatum, commonly known as Sweet St. John's Wort, is a plant species in the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and depression, as well as its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sweet St. John's Wort include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phytosterols, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
